build_triton_pointwise_config: build a pointwise triton kernel config from size hints and tile hints for autotuning
build_triton_reduction_config: build a reduction triton kernel config from size hints and reduction hints for autotuning
build_triton_autotuner: build a caching autotuner that benchmarks triton kernel configs and caches best config to disk
build_triton_grid: build a triton grid function from numel arguments for computing launch grid dimensions
build_triton_persistent_reduction_config: build a persistent reduction triton kernel config from size hints and reduction hints
